note: A headless Minecraft client — a bot, not a person — joined a Paper server, signed in with a social-style login, bought iron and received the ingot in a real PlayerInventory, then sold it back. Every write was relayed, so the player paid no gas. The server ran online-mode=false because a headless client has no Mojang account; npm run mc:server, which is the documented way to run this, keeps online-mode=true.
